# Beach Advisories {#sec-beachadvisories}  

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(mseptools)
library(tmap)

load(here::here("data",
                "beach_advisories",
                "beach_advisories_2025.RData"))

# render the maps interactively or statically
out_format <- knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.pandoc.to")

if (is.null(out_format) || out_format == "html") {
  message("Setting tmap mode to 'view'")
  tmap_mode("view")
} else {
  message("Setting tmap mode to 'plot'")
  tmap_mode("plot")
}
```


This section will be based on data from [beaches.mdeq.ms.gov](https://beaches.mdeq.ms.gov/).  

## Overall Summary  

**Note: These summaries are NOT factual.** They are examples of how we might want to talk about what we find, to help ensure we do calculations in the right way. I am completely making up details and could be very, very wrong. Please do not treat this information as factual.    


e.g. "Overall, the number of beach advisory days was lower than normal, and at *example hot spot stations* in particular, the number has been decreasing."  


## Supporting Information  


### DEQ Beach Sampling  

Make a map where each station is represented by a point, and the point size is based on the number of days that station was under advisory in the year.  

no. of beach closure days by station (see PPBEP's online map)  


-  Can download advisory/closure info from DEQ: https://beaches.mdeq.ms.gov/Historical/HCA 
-  Per station, calculate # advisories/closures, # days under advisory/closure (total), mean or median # days per advisory/closure
-  Aggregate across coast: how many days under advisory/closure across all stations (sum of station totals); break down whether it’s just a few troublesome sites (seems to be based on presentations I’ve seen from DEQ) and what % of advisory/closure days came from those few sites  


```{r}
summ_2025 <- beach_advisories_2025 |> 
  rename(station = `Station Number`) |> 
  summarize(.by = station,
            n_advs = n(),
            days_advs_2025 = sum(days_in_2025),
            days_per_advs_min = min(days_in_2025),
            days_per_advs_median = round(median(days_in_2025)),
            days_per_advs_mean = round(mean(days_in_2025)),
            days_per_advs_max = max(days_in_2025)) |> 
  full_join(MDEQ_beach_stations,
            by = c("station" = "DEQStationID")) |> 
  mutate(n_advs = case_when(is.na(n_advs) ~ 0,
                            .default = n_advs),
         days_advs_2025 = case_when(is.na(days_advs_2025) ~ 0,
                                    .default = days_advs_2025)) |> 
  arrange(station) |> 
  st_as_sf(crs = st_crs(MDEQ_beach_stations))
```


```{r}
# using tmap v3 code
# m1 <- tm_shape(summ_2025) +
#   tm_basemap() +
#   tm_bubbles(size = "days_advs_2025",
#              scale = 1.3,
#              col = "brown",
#              fill_alpha = 0.6,
#              # col = "white",
#              title.size = "Total Days under Advisory in 2025")

# updated for tmap v4
m1 <- tm_shape(summ_2025) +
  tm_basemap() +
  tm_bubbles(
    size = "days_advs_2025",
    size.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values.scale = 1.3),
    size.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Total Days under Advisory in 2025",
      orientation = "landscape"
      ),
    fill = "brown",
    fill_alpha = 0.6
  )

tmap_hydro(m1)
```
